updateHint: Official stable channel · Verified downloads. Android requires system installation approval. Windows may still show an unknown publisher warning.
updateConfirm: Save all changes first. Continue downloading and installing the verified update? Windows will close this app. Android will ask for installation approval.
updateState_idle: Check the official release channel for a newer version.
updateState_installing: Downloading and verifying… Do not close the app.
updateState_installer: Installer opened. Confirm installation in the system dialog; if cancelled, you can retry.
updateState_error: Update failed; your installed version is unchanged. Check your connection and retry. On Android, allow installs from this app in system settings, then retry. A release may not yet be available.
heading: Make yourself at home.
